intro: Your dog or cat doesn't have to stay home. These 751 luxury hotels welcome pets, from Kimpton and Thompson to Four Seasons, The Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, Park Hyatt and independent country houses across Europe. You'll find them in more than 60 countries, with the most in New York, San Francisco, Paris, London, Chicago, Washington DC, Rome and Milan.

Book through WhataHotel! and you pay the hotel's own rate, with our preferred-partner perks added where the hotel offers them. Pet rules are set by each hotel, and they change. Before you book, a Lorraine Travel advisor will confirm the details for your pet: the fee, the weight limit, how many pets are allowed and which room types qualify.
